_doc: Hand-entered Rogue effects (Forever). Scope tags: builder (Sinister Strike or Backstab source), builder-dagger (Backstab/Mutilate source), finisher, poison, offhand, weapon:sword, weapon:dagger.

Improved Gouge.note: +0.5s/rank Gouge: bandage/reset utility while leveling. 2026-09-27 audit: the sword loop never Gouges (fight lab 0.0 +-0.0 at 60); Gouge -> Backstab is the dagger loop before Mutilate. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Remorseless Attacks.note: +20%/rank crit on the first builder after a kill: ~1 of 6 builders while leveling -> +0.7%/rank builder damage; nothing in raids. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 1.4% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 1.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (1.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Ruthlessness.note: 20%/rank chance for a free combo point after a finisher: 0.6 CP per finisher at 3/3 = ~12% fewer builders per finisher -> ~+2%/rank damage. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 0.1% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-02, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, combat-daggers-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 4.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 3.8% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (3.8%). Other modes unchanged.

Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 2.9% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.4% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (2.5%). Mutilate.note: Both weapons for 75% damage each + flat, 2 combo points, +20% vs poisoned targets, no positional requirement: replaces Backstab as the dagger builder at ~+20% builder damage and +100% CP rate per use (offset by 60 energy). Applies to the dagger builder only. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, burst: 2 combo points per global from any angle (3 with a Seal Fate crit): 5-point Kidney Shot and Eviscerate inside one stun, where Backstab needs the target's back. Daggers only (beta spellbook: Requires Daggers); its damage is counted.

Improved Kidney Shot.note: Bosses are stun-immune: PvP only. PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: The Kidney Shot target takes +10% from your attacks and poisons for up to 6 s (20 s cd): the kill window for Cold Blood Eviscerate. Own damage only (Classic: all sources); the model gives it 0; core of pvp-seal-fate-daggers.

Seal Fate.note: 20%/rank chance for an extra CP when a builder crits: raid crit ~32% -> +0.064 CP per builder per rank (~+6% finisher rate at 5/5 = +1.2%/rank damage); leveling crit ~10% -> +0.4%/rank. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 5.9% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 4.8% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (4.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Venom.note: Finisher: +30% poison damage and +10% application for up to 21s (kept up in raids): ~+35% poison damage minus the finishers spent (~-3% Eviscerate). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-26, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, combat-daggers-raid): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.2%). Other modes unchanged. 2026-09-27 audit: no simulated rotation casts it (the fight lab's priority list, none of the simulator's rogue APLs): 0 until one does (unverified). PvP (2026-09-27): low, stick: Finisher: +10% poison application and +30% poison damage for up to 21 s keeps Crippling and Wound up, but it spends the combo points of a Kidney Shot or Eviscerate. 31-point capstone; unverified.

Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 4.4% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 1.0% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x4.44 to match (4.4%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, combat-swords-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 0.3% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.6% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.55 to match (0.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Raid sim calibration (2026-10-02, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, combat-daggers-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 6.3% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 5.3% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (5.3%). Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 1.5% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (2.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Endurance.note: -30%/rank Sprint and Evasion cooldowns (60% at 2/2, Classic 30%): Evasion every 2 min instead of 5 while leveling -> +3%/rank survivability plus escape utility; raid filler. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 2.6% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.6% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x3.85 to match (2.7%). Other modes unchanged.

Riposte.note: 150% weapon damage + disarm after a parry: leveling (mobs face you and get parried) ~+3% damage; raids 0 (you attack from behind). Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 2.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.9% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (2.8%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Sprint.note: Snare removal on Sprint: PvP. 2026-09-27 audit: it breaks snares when Sprint is cast and adds no speed; no leveling or raid use (PvP escape). PvP (2026-09-27): medium, escape: Sprint removes all snares and roots (100% at 2/2): the answer to Frost Nova, Hamstring, Concussive Shot, Entangling Roots and Frost Shock; every 2 min with Endurance. Combat builds (audit: high; one break per Sprint).

Improved Kick.note: Silence on Kick: dungeon/PvP. 2026-09-27 audit: Kick's own 5 s lockout already stops a caster mob (fight lab -0.1% +-1.0 single-target and in pulls): +2 adds at 60 only. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stun: Kick silences for 2 s (100% at 2/2), locking every school, not only the kicked one: against healers and casters. Needs 15 Combat points; combat builds (audit: high).

Flawless Execution.note: Flawless Execution (replaced Restless Blades in beta build 1.60.1.69893): Eviscerate costs 10 less Energy (35 -> 25). One finisher per ~13s saves ~0.8 Energy/s against ~10.5 Energy/s income (+7% Energy), and Energy-bound yellow damage is ~55% of the total -> ~+4% melee damage in Eviscerate builds (raid and leveling); nothing for Rupture/Slice-and-Dice-only rotations. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 3.9% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.8% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x4.40 to match (3.8%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-02, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, combat-swords-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 0.5% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (0.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 8.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 6.5% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x1.34 to match (8.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Raid sim calibration (2026-10-02, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, combat-daggers-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 1.6% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.9% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 4.1% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 3.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (3.2%). Other modes unchanged. Other modes unchanged.

Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 1.7% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); re-seeded from its tooltip (an earlier fit had left its values at zero), already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (2.2%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-02, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, combat-daggers-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 4.1% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 4.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (4.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Raid sim calibration (2026-10-02, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, combat-daggers-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 17.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 15.4% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (15.4%). Camouflage.note: Stealth speed/cooldown: leveling utility. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 1.6% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Master of Deception.note: Stealth detection: leveling/PvP utility. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stealth: Detected as if 3 levels higher: get the opener against alert players and other rogues; both drafts take 3/3 (audit: high; it only matters when the target faces you or detects stealth).

Setup.note: 33%/rank CP on dodge/resist: leveling ~+0.5%/rank. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, avoid: A combo point on every dodge or full resist (100% at 3/3): Evasion against a warrior or rogue fills combo points for Kidney Shot. Melee opponents only. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 7.7% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.3% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x24.24 to match (8.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Elusiveness.note: Vanish/Blind cooldown: PvP; small leveling survivability. PvP (2026-09-27): high, escape: Vanish and Blind cooldowns -90 s (5 -> 3.5 min): the escape, snare break and restealth reset plus a 10 s CC more often; both drafts take 2/2.

Dirty Tricks.note: Cheaper Sap/Blind: PvP. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stun: Sap and Blind cost -50% (Blind 30 -> 15 Energy, Sap about 33): Blind inside an energy-starved stun chain, Sap then open. The audit's swap for Improved Distract in pvp-hemo-prep.

Improved Ambush.note: +15%/rank Ambush crit: the stealth opener while leveling (~+1%/rank of fight damage with daggers). PvP (2026-09-27): medium, burst: +45% Ambush crit: the Ambush opener crits against cloth. The spec models have no Ambush source, so this is its whole value; both drafts take 3/3 (audit: high; opener only).

Initiative.note: 33%/rank extra CP on openers: ~+1%/rank leveling (one opener per fight). PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stealth: +1 combo point on Cheap Shot, Ambush and Garrote (100% at 3/3): Cheap Shot, one builder, 5-point Kidney Shot. Opener only (audit: high); both drafts take 3/3.

Ghostly Strike.note: 125% (180% dagger) weapon damage + 15% dodge 7s every 20s: parser read the dodge as permanent; ~5% average dodge and ~+1% damage. PvP (2026-09-27): low, avoid: +15% dodge for 7 s on demand (20 s cd) against melee burst. The average is already counted as survival (audit: medium).

Improved Distract.note: PvP/stealth utility. PvP (2026-09-27): low, stealth: Distract +5 yd and distracted players detect you as if 2 more levels lower: sneak past alert targets; rarely decides a fight (the audit's weakest pick in pvp-hemo-prep).

Heightened Senses.note: Stealth detection and -2%/rank chance to be hit by spells/ranged: small survivability. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stealth: Detect stealth as if 3 levels higher (rogues and cat druids open on you less) and -4% chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks (fewer Polymorphs, Fears, Scatter Shots). The hit part is counted as survival (audit: high).

Premeditation.note: 2 CP from stealth every 2 min: leveling opener (+1%). PvP (2026-09-27): high, stun: 2 combo points (2 min cd, 20 s window): Cheap Shot + Initiative + Premeditation is an immediate 5-point Kidney Shot, 10 s of stun. Core of pvp-hemo-prep; the 1.60.1.70009 spellbook lists no Stealth requirement (Classic had one).

Serrated Blades.note: Parsed +10%/rank Rupture; also 3%/rank armor ignore (~+1%/rank physical damage).

Dirty Deeds.note: Cheaper Cheap Shot/Garrote, Garrote from the front: PvP/leveling opener. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stealth: Cheap Shot and Garrote -20 Energy, Garrote from the front: more Energy after the opener for the Kidney Shot chain (audit: high; opener only).

Preparation.note: Resets cooldowns every 10 min: leveling/PvP survivability. PvP (2026-09-27): high, escape: Finishes every other rogue cooldown (10 min cd): a second Vanish, Sprint, Evasion, Blind and Cold Blood in the same fight. Namesake of pvp-hemo-prep; the reset list is unconfirmed in Forever.

Hemorrhage.note: 35-energy builder (100% weapon, 145% dagger) + Rupture debuff: with Aggression-buffed Sinister Strike/Backstab available it is roughly a sidegrade; PvP-oriented. 0 here.

Quietus.note: +2%/rank SS/Hemo/Ghostly Strike damage below 35% health (~30% of a fight) -> +0.6%/rank on the builder.

Cutthroat.note: Backstab enables an out-of-stealth Ambush 3%/rank: ~+0.5%/rank dagger damage. PvP (2026-09-27): low, burst: Backstab has a 15% chance to allow one Ambush out of stealth within 10 s: a burst crit with Improved Ambush, but Backstab needs the target's back. Dagger Subtlety only.

Thousand Cuts.note: Rupture ticks make Hemorrhage/Backstab up to 15 energy cheaper: ~+4% dagger builder damage if Rupture is kept up.
